fact: The GPE panel reported on 5 February 2023 that Lesotho's EMIS is paper-based and does not collect and track data for individual schools, learners and teachers, that its capacity is weak for want of staff and funding, and that a Community Systems Foundation mission set for November 2022 was to upgrade it to OpenEMIS.
title: Report of the Independent Technical Advisory Panel (ITAP): assessment of Enabling Factors, Lesotho
